run_profile_memory_usage: run the script to profile memory footprint of Meta-World hard mode environments
run_build_and_step: run build_and_step to create, reset, and step through a single Meta-World environment
run_build_and_step_all: run build_and_step_all to create and step through all environments in a class list
run_profile_hard_mode_indepedent: run profile_hard_mode_indepedent to measure per-environment memory usage for hard mode tasks
run_profile_hard_mode_shared: run profile_hard_mode_shared to measure shared memory usage across all hard mode environments
